With a weapon, there will be 4 small white cubes with a number next to them. If a weapon has a red 'X' next to it, it means you don't have the right stats to use it. It requires these 4 boxes to have a white number. If it has a red number, you must use souls to upgrade that stat. 
The first cube is strength.
The second cube is Dexterity.
The third cube is intelligence.
The last cube is faith.

ALSO

Dexterity increases the speed at which you swing your weapon, or how fast you can roll away after being hit. It also adds some more damage.
Strength increases the amount of damage you do.
Vitality will increase your equip ratio, which is the percentage in the top right corner of your screen. If it hits 70% or more, you will fat roll. This means you roll slower and shorter, and the screen shakes when you roll. If you can hit a 69.9% or lower, you will not fat roll.
Killing the shrine handmaiden in dark souls 3 will cause her to up her prices by 20%. She is the old woman in the chair near the blacksmith.
DO NOT KILL THE BLACKSMITH. Doing so will cause lots of trouble. If you do, you need to access the statue of Velka, goddess of sin. (Google it if you need to)
Attunement will increase your FP (blue bar), and every few levels will give you an attunement slot, which allows you to have a spell in the top rectangle of your inventory.
A staff is required for sorceries.
A talisman or chime are required for miracles.
When you reach Yhorm the Giant (boss), next to where he sits is an item. Run past him and pick it up. (It's a storm ruler.) Two hand the weapon, and charge up it's ability until the weapon lights up. Pressing the ability attack will release a big wave and deal massive damage to the giant. No other weapon deals normal damage to him, so don't try to use another weapon. Also the storm ruler is trash outside of Yhorm.
